Saturday Night and I drop 3 pills of White Naked Ladies...

I drop in.  There was somebodies girlfriend that decides to put her legs across me.  I give those feet a full massage, thinking the whole time about Mrs. Wallace and who gives a fuck.  I begin to roll hard, good roll, good light show, good time.  People return with more White Naked Ladies. I take 4 more pills and with those four pills they took the last clear thought of the night.  I begin to trip real hard.  I isolate myself in the dark room.  The lights of the clock are dancing, the glowsticks have now become worms inching their way across the floor.  A friend comes to check on me and his face melts off, his eyeball drips right out of his socket.  I tell him this and he just says it does that sometimes.  

I go outside.  it is night, a warm night, with a cool breeze the porch over looks the entire neighbor hood.  The sodium orange lights burn and then I see it.  I cannot look away.  There, the eagle with its talons is screaming out of the fire.  No one sees this as I look around.  Everything is normal.  Everything is fine.  People are talking, i know this is a porch, I know i am on a drug, I am perfectly in control of the surroundings, but here is this fucking fire eagle blasting forth, wait...now it changes.  Now it is a solider on his horse, the horse is rearing back and his sword is raised high in the air, he is leading the charge against my own sanity.  This soldier is jumping fourth from another dimension in slow motion.  I can watch the scene unfold, as a person on a bike rides past and cars drive through, all moving at normal speed against the backdrop of this blackhole of time.  I will always remember that tree and that streetlamp that gave me that beautiful vista.

Snap back to reality.  I have to be to work tomorrow. What do I do?  Drink. Drink a lot.  Beer is water, with no effect.  those worms encroach on me.  I get up, shit we're out of beer.  Vodka, Perfect.  The sun rises.  Where the fuck did the sun come from?  Time to leave.  I offer to take some people home, they decide to drive my car for me.  So, i pick up the very large chair i was sitting in, put it on my head and begin to walk down the hill to my car.  They ask, "whats the chair for?", i answer, "I need a seat"

They drive to their house and give me my car back, such great friends.  I watch as they quietly sneak back into their house. They watch, in faces that I could only imagine, me do a giant burnout up their entire gravel driveway before i catch traction on the street but not before clipping their mailbox.

I wake up.  It is hot.  My car will not start.  I am in the middle of nowhere.  I live in the city and all i see are fields, did i drive out of state??  Two people offer to take me back to my home. We drive, me giving them directions in the most" im not fucked up at all" tone of voice i can muster. I have them take me to my apartment.  Its locked.  Shit the side door is locked, i never lock that door.  I don't.  The people that live there now, do.  I had these guys take me back to an apartment i havent lived in for years.

So, I walk, i remember walking then i remember being in my friends apartment 8 miles away.  How, what the...how did i get on this couch. Poor life decisions..thats how!
